pairs.subject: prompt-assembly
pairs.evidence: clients/typescript/src/index.ts:1 The package is a typed dataset-mirror and watermark-sync client that makes no model calls and assembles no prompts. A search of clients/typescript (node_modules included) found no system_prompt, max_tokens, compaction or context_window. The only 'prompt' hit is a proposal-summary field in the generated wire types, not prompt assembly.

pairs.subject: prompt-assembly
pairs.evidence: crates/core/migrations/0009_research_cache.sql:3 The migrations only define storage. The one LLM-adjacent table, research_cache, stores answers under a hash key and has no column for prompt layers, budgets or history. A search of crates/core/migrations found no system_prompt, max_tokens, compaction or context_window, so the prompt-assembly precondition does not hold here.
